title: New Klaviyo BFCM Updates: Composer, Customer Agent, and More
summary: Composer builds BFCM campaigns from your docs, Customer Agent remembers shoppers across channels, and 4 more Klaviyo updates help you approve and send faster.
body_markdown:
Six updates to simplify BFCM workflows


Generated by Klaviyo AI


Klaviyo’s six updates address BFCM campaign creation, customer support, email approvals, campaign organization, sending capacity, and image translation. The post explains how Composer builds from existing briefs, Customer Agent retains cross-channel context, and other tools reduce manual work during the holiday rush.


-


**Campaign creation:** Composer connects to more than 10 apps to build campaigns, flows, and tests from existing briefs, with approval required before sending.


-


**Customer support:** Customer Agent remembers shoppers across channels, while assignment notifications, spam rules, and AI conversation ratings support service teams.


-


**Approvals and organization:** Shareable previews and version history simplify email review, while nested folders and Bulk Move organize campaigns without changing their schedules or reporting.


-


**Peak sending capacity:** New infrastructure can send 100 million messages in 20 minutes, with a dedicated pipeline for eligible flows.


-


**Image translation:** Smart Translations translates text within static email images on paid plans, preserves names on a do-not-translate list, and requires review before sending.


[Sign up](https://www.klaviyo.com/sign-up)[Get a demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/demo-request)


---


Starting today, Klaviyo’s AI marketing agent,[Composer](https://www.klaviyo.com/composer) , builds your holiday campaigns from the brief you already wrote. Customer Agent picks up shopper conversations across channels without starting over. And 4 more updates make approvals, campaign organization, sending, and translation faster, with Black Friday only 10 days away.


Here’s what we just released to remove friction and help you move faster to help your Q4 goals.


## **Composer builds BFCM campaigns from your brief**


Most BFCM plans live in docs, sheets, and project tools. Composer now connects to more than[10 apps](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/how-to-connect-and-use-apps-in-composer) your team already uses, reads the brief, and builds the campaigns, flows, and tests in Klaviyo.


Say your promo calendar lives in Google Drive. Give Composer one prompt:


Read our BFCM plan in Google Drive


Read our BFCM plan in Google Drive. Build the early access campaign, the Black Friday doorbuster, and the Cyber Monday last-chance send, each with an A/B test on the subject line.


[Campaign A/B testing](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/52308788113307) in Composer builds those test variants in the same conversation that built the campaign. Composer drafts. You decide. Nothing sends until you approve it.


And when Cyber Monday wraps, you can skip the weekend you’d normally spend building the recap deck.[Artifacts in Composer](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/57927505009307) turns your results into a dashboard or a slide deck you can share with your team or download as a PDF or PowerPoint.


## **Shoppers tell their story once with Customer Agent**


BFCM brings a wave of “where’s my order” questions across chat, text, and email, with a pile of spam on top. With cross-channel memory,[Customer Agent](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai/customer-agent) now remembers each shopper across every one of your channels, because nobody wants to explain a late package more than once.


Behind the scenes, 3 updates help your support team keep pace with the rush:


- **Assignment notification emails** let reps know the moment a ticket is theirs.
- **Spam to intake rules** take one message marked as spam and create a rule that catches similar ones.
- [CX Score](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/understanding-cx-score) uses AI to rate each conversation, with no survey needed.


## **Approve BFCM emails with one link**


BFCM approvals usually mean test sends, screenshots, and someone overwriting the version everyone already signed off on. Here are two Klaviyo updates to help make this easier.


- **Shareable preview links** let you share an email with up to 10 reviewers, like a client, your manager, or legal. Reviewers don’t need a Klaviyo login, and they see the latest version whenever they open the link.
- **Version history** has your back when a bad edit slips into a drag-and-drop[email template](https://www.klaviyo.com/features/email-templates) . Restore an earlier version in one click.


Screenshot threads can retire for the season, and no one needs to guess which version got approved.


## **Keep your BFCM campaign list in order**


By Cyber Monday, your campaign list is a wall of early access, doorbuster, last chance, and resend campaigns.


[Folders in Campaigns](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/58304860273307) let you group them up to 10 levels deep, and Bulk Move files them fast. A folder called BFCM 2026, with Early access, Doorbusters, and Resends inside it, is a beautiful thing at 11 p.m. on Black Friday.


Search across all folders still finds any campaign, wherever it lives. And moving a campaign doesn’t change its status, schedule, content, or reporting, so getting organized doesn’t put a send at risk.


## **Send at peak volume without the wait**


The busiest send of the year is no time to wait in line.


Klaviyo’s new sending infrastructure can send 100 million messages in 20 minutes. Eligible flows also get their own dedicated pipeline, a fast lane that keeps flow messages moving across email, text, mobile push, and WhatsApp. Now, your abandoned cart reminders don’t have to wait for your biggest campaign of the year to finish sending.


Klaviyo also earned ISO 27018 certification, the international standard for protecting personal data in the cloud. It joins Klaviyo’s ISO 27001 and ISO 27017 certifications, which gives your security team one more reason to say yes.


## **Your hero banner speaks French in Paris and German in Berlin**


Your BFCM hero banner says “40% off, ends tonight.” Your shoppers in Paris, Berlin, and Madrid shouldn’t have to read it in English.


[Smart Translations](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/57577473515803) for images translates the text inside your email images. Klaviyo reads the text in the image, translates it into each language you send in, and creates a new version with the translated text in place. Now, one banner from your designer works in each market, with no redesign required.


Add your brand and product names to your do-not-translate list first, and they come through exactly as written. Image translation works on static images in campaign and flow emails, and it’s part of Smart Translations on paid Klaviyo plans. Review each translated image before you send.


## **Get started before Black Friday**


If you’re already on Klaviyo, open Composer and hand it your BFCM brief. Then send your first preview link to your team to fore review and approval. For benchmarks, templates, and playbooks in the case you aren’t ready for next week, visit our[BFCM hub](https://www.klaviyo.com/bfcm) .


If you’re not on Klaviyo yet, plenty of the brands you’ll compete with on Black Friday already are.
